description: From the Plaza de Santa María, Jaén Cathedral's vast Renaissance façade fills the frame, its carved stonework glowing under the night lighting that visitors say should not be missed. Twin towers anchor the wide front above the square's benches. On a clear 22°C night, the 16th-century masterpiece — the model for cathedrals across Spain and the Americas — stands in a pool of light with the hill of Santa Catalina dark behind.
